description: This Java class 'CoapTransportResource' handles CoAP protocol requests within the Thingsboard server, managing device communication, session handling, and resource observation for CoAP devices.

classes.name: DeviceProvisionCallback
classes.description: Callback handler for device provisioning responses, sending appropriate CoAP responses based on success or failure.

classes.name: CoapResourceObserver
classes.description: Implements ResourceObserver to manage CoAP observe relations, registering and deregistering observe relations.

methods.name: processHandleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests, routing based on feature type and observe options.

methods.name: processExchangeGetRequest
methods.description: Processes observe GET requests for subscriptions or unsubscriptions.

methods.name: processHandlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests, routing based on feature type and request specifics.

methods.name: processProvision
methods.description: Handles device provisioning requests, decoding messages and invoking processing service.

methods.name: processRequest
methods.description: Main request processing method, handling device session info and credentials.

methods.name: processAccessTokenRequest
methods.description: Processes requests with access tokens, authenticating devices.

methods.name: processRequest
methods.description: Overloaded method to process device requests with credentials and profiles, dispatching to specific handlers.

methods.name: handlePostAttributesRequest
methods.description: Processes POST attributes requests, converting and forwarding to transport service.

methods.name: handlePostTelemetryRequest
methods.description: Processes POST telemetry requests, converting and forwarding to transport service.

methods.name: handleClaimRequest
methods.description: Processes device claim requests.

methods.name: handleAttributeSubscribeRequest
methods.description: Handles attribute subscription requests.

methods.name: handleAttributeUnsubscribeRequest
methods.description: Handles attribute unsubscription requests.

methods.name: handleRpcUnsubscribeRequest
methods.description: Handles RPC unsubscription requests.

methods.name: handleToDeviceRpcResponse
methods.description: Processes responses from devices for RPC calls.

methods.name: handleRpcSubscribeRequest
methods.description: Handles RPC subscription requests.

methods.name: handleGetAttributesRequest
methods.description: Processes get attributes requests.

methods.name: handleToServerRpcRequest
methods.description: Processes server RPC requests.

methods.name: deferAccept
methods.description: Schedules acceptance of exchange, enabling piggyback responses.

methods.name: toSessionId
methods.description: Converts session info proto to UUID.

methods.name: getTokenFromRequest
methods.description: Extracts token string from request.

methods.name: decodeCredentials
methods.description: Decodes device credentials from request URI path.

methods.name: getFeatureType
methods.description: Determines feature type from request URI path.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Extracts request ID from request URI path.

methods.name: getCoapDtlsSessionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves DTLS session info based on endpoint context.

methods.name: getCertPem
methods.description: Extracts certificate PEM string from endpoint context.
